statement:
I'll look up the trip record first to check the recorded flight details.
The recorded flight-out date of 16 March is not safe or correct: Dana gives her talk on the morning of 13 March, so a 16 March flight would arrive after the conference has ended (and after her hotel checkout on 15 March), meaning she'd miss the entire event. I'll book the 12 March flight instead so she arrives before her talk.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The recorded flight-out date of 16 March is not safe or correct" because it postdates the talk and hotel stay, and gives the corrected 12 March flight.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
